input.business_intent: I want to use this data to identify the top-performing product categories by total sales revenue for each store region.

args.sql_query:
-- Query 1: Comprehensive ranking of all categories by region and revenue
SELECT 
    region,
    fk_category AS category,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_transaction_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC) AS rank_in_region
FROM gold_product_category_sales_by_region
GROUP BY region, fk_category
ORDER BY region, total_revenue DESC

-- Query 2: Top 5 categories per region for visualization
SELECT 
    region,
    fk_category AS category,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC) AS rank_in_region
FROM gold_product_category_sales_by_region
GROUP BY region, fk_category
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC) <= 5
ORDER BY region, total_revenue DESC

-- Query 3: Regional summary statistics
SELECT 
    region,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_region_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fk_category) AS num_categories,
    COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
    ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_transaction_value,
    ROUND(MAX(total_amount), 2) AS max_transaction_value
FROM gold_product_category_sales_by_region
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY total_region_revenue DESC
